title: PHP product search page
context: Product search page. The query string q is shown back to the user in the page. Results are paged with 20 per page; page is 1-based and must be a positive integer.
code: $sql = "SELECT id, name, price FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%$q%' LIMIT 20 OFFSET $offset";

expected.why: page is never validated as a positive integer, so "0", "-5" or "abc" give negative or broken offsets
q and offset are interpolated into the SQL (injection); use bound parameters
q is echoed without htmlspecialchars (reflected XSS)
